notes.title: New Content Update for Toybit Quest
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32904364/4e86ba2632c492f8f42c0b9d5106082d69725a85.png

Some have stated how the game was very hard, especially in the first few levels, so a lot of the new content and changes are to make the game easier for you to reach the endgame content.  

Added Content and Changes

 A second set of permanent upgrades are available in the store. This will allow the player to obtain more upgrades the more coins they collect throughout all of their runs(as they keep their coins even if they die). 

 The player now starts with 4 health instead of 3

 The player's ultimate invincibility ability now lasts longer

I really hope this will help in your attempts to reach the endgame of Toybit Quest

notes.title: New Update Released! Making Things a Bit Easier
notes.notes:
Changelog Update 1.1

Most changes were made to make the game less challenging (especially in the first few levels) and easier for the player to understand what is going on.


Increased player attack speed
Reduced cooldown on hammer spin ability
Reduced health of dice, marbles, and army men enemies
Reduced marble spawn on marble bag boss
Added more instructions at the beginning of the game 
Added battery health drop at the beginning
Added more ways to get coins
